description:
Look up a single carrier's current profile by USDOT number. Paid —
you pay only when a call returns records; an exact-key miss is free.

Returns every carrier_status (Active, Inactive, Pending) — check the
carrier_status field, don't assume Active.

insurance_cancel_pending is true when an insurance cancellation is on
file and not yet effective as of record_as_of (rare: dozens of carriers,
not thousands). Compare soonest_cancel_effective_date with today: the
data is a monthly snapshot, so the cancellation may already have taken
effect. days_to_cancel_effective counts from record_as_of, not today.

Carries no contact information (legal_name, dba_name, addresses,
phone, email — removed 2026-09-19, see schemas.CarrierProfile). The one
legitimate use those fields served — confirming a carrier's claimed
identity against records, e.g. to catch a carrier-identity-theft
("double brokering") attempt — is available instead via claimed_name
(matched against legal_name OR dba_name) and claimed_street/
claimed_city/claimed_state/claimed_zip (matched against
physical_address; supply any subset). Returns name_match/
physical_address_match as a boolean per claim actually supplied, `null`
for a claim not supplied — never the value on file itself.
name: lookup_carrier
